directive.thread_id: launch-video port lane 2026-11-05: recipe nutrients from FoodData Central
directive.quote: Port every behaviour one to one (unit handling, nutrient id fallbacks, portions, rounding).

targets.baseline_commit_message: work-out-a-recipes-nutrients-from-fooddata-central: the byte copy of launch-video's recipe profile reader and summer

preserve: each ingredient's share is per-100 g x grams / 100 x scale, kept to 4 places; totals are summed unrounded
the mix mass is the grams of every ingredient with an FDC id
per batch and per 100 g to 3 places, % DRI to 1 place, on the lower of male and female: gap under 10, low under 33, a third or more under 100, else a full day
sodium is a limit, not a gap; a main ingredient with no value makes the flag unknown_lower_bound_only with the caveat naming every ingredient without data
allowed_deltas: per_tub is per_batch (the field no longer names one recipe's container)
the two main ingredients named in code are the ingredients the request marks base
the calcium caveat written in code is the request's nutrient_caveats
banned_substitutions: a person's recipe, grams, label numbers or words written in code
a second summing or flagging path
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it. Lines 101-115 and 153-197 of the same file are one person's recipe, evidence and words: they did not move as code, they are the request (README, The request), so they are not a source here.
